correctness.rationale: For the explicit equilateral no-eclipse scatterers, the normal-incidence two-bounce ray and centroid-facing three-bounce ray satisfy exact specular reflection (incidence c=√3/2). The equatorial ellipsoid second fundamental form has principal curvatures 1/r and β²/r. Projecting displacement to ray-normal sections yields planar kick 2/(rc) and vertical kick 2β²c/r; free flight shear and kick have symplectic trace 2+ℓψ. Thus per-collision positive log multipliers are arcosh(1+ℓψ/2) for each periodic ray. Comparisons give β>1 in the 2-cycle and β<2/√3 opposite ordering in the 3-cycle, independent of D/r. Strict gaps obstruct a fixed canonical dominated line ordering, persist under small scatterer perturbations; numerical independent test at both sides and exact crossing corroborated. This does not rule out all other dominated splittings or Gibbs-measure orderings.
